title: alchemilla vulgaris var. obtusa
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris var. obtusa, commonly known as the less common variety of the Lady's Mantle, is a type of flowering plant in the rose family. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in wound healing, reducing menstrual cramps, and soothing digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla vulgaris var. obtusa include its ability to act as an astringent, anti-inflammatory, and vulnerary agent. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, tannins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
